posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
[quote:6d0966002a]Has anyone on this forum ever used PFG-04?[/quote:6d0966002a]

I've also been curious if anyone had tried PFG-04. So far, I don't know of anyone. Apparently one problem is that they need quite a large order before they'll make it. Personally, one problem I see is the age of the film. I've found that DCG's characteristics alter quite a bit after about a week. It doesn't really have much of a shelf life. This is due to "dark reaction".

[quote:6d0966002a]Although he hasn't advertised it *nudge* so I don't know what the availability is.[/quote:6d0966002a]. 

I've been putting off making any changes to the site because a major rework of the site is underway, thanks to Danny's help.

They're 4 dollars (US) each for a 4x5 or $20 for an 8x10 plus shipping. We don't require any minimum order. I obviously can't speak for the quality. Mark Cavin has been kind enough to say this: [http://holographyforum.org/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=1541](http://holographyforum.org/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=1541)
